sector_model: Bank model: price to book and tangible book, earnings on common after preferred dividends, deposits, credit quality; a pending transformative merger means standalone ratios describe the legacy bank only.
thesis: WaFd (Nasdaq: WAFD; fiscal year ends 09-30) screened as a cheap bank, but it is party to a pending all stock reverse merger with EverBank Financial (agreement 2026-09-06 per press summaries; former EverBank holders about 59.2% and WaFd holders about 40.8%; about 107.3M shares issued; special meeting 2026-12-16; close expected early 2027; DEFM14A filed 2026-11-04). The proxy itself could not be read (the SEC site blocked automated access and no workaround was attempted); the deal facts come from secondary news summaries and are unverified. Legacy standalone figures from XBRL (10-Qs): net income 9M FY26 (10-01-2025 to 06-30-2026) 195.9M versus 165.5M; TTM to 06-30-2026 net income 256.5M (= 226.1 + 195.9 - 165.5); 9M net income to common 184.9M vs 154.5M. Balance sheet 06-30-2026: assets 27.60B, deposits 20.93B (down from 21.44B at 09-30-2025), liabilities 24.57B, equity 3.02B including 300M preferred, goodwill 418.4M. Price: close 28.26 on 2026-11-17 (-2.85% on the day) x 73,995,238 shares (10-Q cover, 2026-07-31) = 2.09B = 8.2x TTM net income (before preferred dividends), 0.77x common book (2,722.6M) and at least 0.91x tangible common book before unquantified other intangibles. Because the merged company will be mostly EverBank, these standalone multiples are not a valuation of what shareholders will own; EverBank's financials, exchange terms and pro forma capital were not read. The FY2026 10-K is due about now and is not yet filed.
counterthesis: A low multiple may reflect that WaFd holders become a 40.8% minority in a larger, differently risked bank; EverBank is not public, so its earnings quality, deposit mix and credit were not checked. Deposits shrank 2.4% in nine months while liabilities rose. The 2.85% fall on 11-17 and 4% decline since 11-13 are unexplained. Stock issuance approval is a vote on 2026-12-16 and could fail. Merger accretion claims (29% EPS accretion for 2027) are management projections.
invalidation: Not applicable until the proxy is read; the idea is invalid as a standalone cheap bank thesis if EverBank pro forma metrics are weaker than WaFd's, if tangible book dilution exceeds the claimed under two year earn back, or if the vote or regulatory approvals fail and the legacy bank trades back at a premium to the current price.
